scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,ui 'npm run dev -w api' 'npm run worker:local -w api' 'npm run dev -w ui'
scripts.dev:aws: concurrently -k -n api,ui 'npm run dev -w api' 'npm run dev -w ui'
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w ui && npm run build:worker
scripts.build:worker: npm run typecheck -w api && tsx scripts/build-worker.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w ui && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
